'''Kalback''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and a distal pod-cousin of Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. He was in his sixties at the time of his final command.<ref name="LSatSoM" />

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Admiral Ackbar temporarily placed the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] in the hands of Admirals Kalback and [[Willham Burke]], who jointly worked to sever the forces of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Leading the fleet from the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']] and [[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|''Remember Alderaan'']], the pair [[Battle of Togoria (Galactic Civil War)|bested]] the warlord's task force at [[Togoria/Legends|Togoria]] and fought their way to the planet [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], where they connected with the forces fielded by the planet [[Contruum/Legends|Contruum]]. Having established a hold on the Perlemian, the two admirals headed in different directions; while Burke pressed Coreward to [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]], Kalback headed for [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]], attempting to secure a position on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. This attempt [[Battle of Corsin (5 ABY)|failed]], as Kalback's ships were met by warlord [[Zsinj]]'s [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Iron Fist (Executor-class)|''Iron Fist'']]. He fell back to [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]], where his forces were added to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Rapid Response Task Force]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Mindor]], he commanded the task force's naval elements from the ''Justice''. He was confident in the abilities of Luke Skywalker and accepted the surrender of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]] during the initial phase of the battle. This turned out to be a ruse, and Kalback met his death on the bridge of the ''Justice'' after a rigged shuttle destroyed his ship, taking a console corner to the head during the series of impacts. Skywalker commended the spirit of the deceased Admiral to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="LSatSoM" />
